title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES THE PHILIPPINE SWEEPSTAKES OFFICE UNDER SUPERVISION DEPARTMENT SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT
title.orig: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES THE PHILIPPINE SWEEPSTAKES OFFICE UNDER SUPERVISION DEPARTMENT SOCIAL WELFARE AND DEVELOPMENT

text.en:
The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office shall hereby be under
the supervision and control of the Department of Social Welfare and Development.
issuances, rules and regulations
or parts thereof
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this8 th day cf; November in the year of our Lord, two
thousand and four.
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
